  "taskPrompt": "Some people believe that mobile phones have improved social communication, while others argue that they harm face-to-face interactions. Discuss both views and give your opinion.",
  "essayText": "Nowadays, mobile phones have become an essential part of daily life. Some people think these devices improve communication between people, while others believe they have negative effects on face-to-face interactions.

On the one hand, mobile phones make communication much easier and faster. People can talk with their friends and family members who live far away instantly through text messages or video calls. Moreover, social media platforms allow individuals to connect with wider groups and share their everyday experiences effortlessly.

On the other hand, heavy reliance on mobile phones can damage real-life relationships. When people spend too much time staring at screens during meals or social gatherings, they ignore the people sitting right next to them. Furthermore, virtual messages lack emotional tone, which often causes misunderstandings among users.

In my opinion, although mobile phones offer convenient connection options, they should be used in moderation to maintain high quality personal communication."
